Current Projects

From fitness facilities to hospitality venues and retail environments, our current projects showcase the versatility and impact of 360° virtual tour technology across diverse sectors.

Fitness & Wellness

Large-Scale Fitness Complex

Comprehensive virtual tour implementation for a major fitness facility, featuring multiple workout areas and specialised training facilities and zones. This project will demonstrate how 360° technology can enhance member onboarding, facility management and space planning.

  • Virtual Navigation: Interactive wayfinding for new members
  • Staff Training: Immersive orientation for equipment and safety protocols
  • Space Optimisation: Optimising for equipment placement and client traffic flow
In Development Expected completion: Q1 2026
Hospitality

Luxury Hotel Experience

Elevated virtual tour solution for a premium hotel property, showcasing guest rooms, dining areas, conference facilities, and amenities. Enhancing guest experience from booking to checkout through immersive virtual previews.

  • Room Previews: Virtual room tours for enhanced booking confidence
  • Venue Showcases: Event spaces and dining areas for planners
  • Guest Services: Virtual concierge and amenity discovery
Planning Phase Capture scheduled: Q1 2026
Retail

Large Retail Innovation

Strategic virtual tour implementation for a large retail environment, focusing on customer journey optimisation, staff training, space planning, product placement efficiency. Initial testbed project demonstrating real-world retail sector applications.

  • Customer Journey: Shopping flow analysis and optimisation
  • Space Planning: Store, stock and car park layout
  • Staff Onboarding: Comprehensive store familiarization training
Discovery Phase Requirements gathering: Q4 2025
